overview_description.description:
Dispatches are intelligent group email addresses for your projects. No more noise. No more hassle.

The Simplicity of Email + The Power of a Project Management System.

Dispatch began at the TechCrunch Disrupt NY Hackathon 2011. It was created by a team of three, including 17 year old [Alex Godin](http://twitter.com/#!/alex_godin), to solve organization problems with file sharing by consolidating files from different web pages.
